quantum_foundations.goal: Find the de Broglie wavelength of an electron in nm, with h in 1e-34 J s, m in 1e-31 kg and v in 1e6 m/s (the unit factors combine to 1 nm).
quantum_foundations.method: A matter wave carries momentum p = h/λ just like a photon; turn that around and use the classical momentum p = mv.

number_systems.goal: Show how many steps of 'add the next one' sum the first n naturals: find twice the sum 1 + 2 + ... + n for n = 100.

vars.n: the last natural number in the sum

number_systems.method: Write the sum forwards and backwards and add them term by term: every pair gives n + 1, and there are n pairs, counted twice. Induction on the successor confirms it.

metamaterials.goal: Find the refractive index of a double-negative metamaterial whose relative permittivity is -4 and relative permeability is -1 (enter the magnitudes; the negative root is taken).
metamaterials.method: In any medium n^2 = εμ. Veselago showed that when both ε and μ are negative, causality forces the negative square root.

chemical_bonding.goal: Find the bond order of the O2 molecule from its molecular-orbital electron counts.
chemical_bonding.method: Each bonding pair lowers the energy and each antibonding pair cancels one bonding pair; count net pairs of electrons that hold the atoms together.

thermodynamics_of_information.goal: Find the Landauer minimum energy to erase one bit at T = 300 K, expressed in units of kB (so the answer is in kelvin).

vars.T: temperature of the environment the bit is erased into (K)

thermodynamics_of_information.method: Erasing a bit halves the number of possible states, an entropy drop of kB ln 2 that must be dumped as heat at temperature T.

entangled_logistics.goal: Find the CHSH value S of a Werner state with visibility V = 0.9 (classical channels cannot exceed 2).

vars.V: visibility (purity) of the entangled pair, 0 to 1

entangled_logistics.method: A perfect Bell pair reaches the Tsirelson bound 2√2; mixing with white noise scales every correlation, and so S, by the visibility.

chronodynamics.goal: Find the minimum energy uncertainty (eV) of a state that lasts Δt = 1 fs, with ħ = 0.658 eV fs.
chronodynamics.method: Energy and time are Fourier partners, so a state confined to a time window has a spread of energies; the energy-time uncertainty relation sets the minimum product.

molecular_biology.goal: Find how many DNA copies exist after g = 10 rounds of replication starting from N0 = 5 molecules.
molecular_biology.method: Semiconservative replication turns every double helix into two each round, so the count doubles g times.

neutrino_physics.goal: Find the oscillation length (km) of a 1 GeV neutrino with mass-squared splitting 0.0025 eV^2.
neutrino_physics.method: The two mass states pick up a relative phase Δm^2 L / (4E); one full oscillation is when it reaches π, giving L = 4πE/Δm^2, which is 2.48 km per GeV/eV^2.

special_relativity.goal: Find the rest energy of 1 kg of matter, with c in units of 1e8 m/s (answer in 1e16 J).
special_relativity.method: Expand the relativistic energy γmc^2 at zero speed: the constant term left over is energy the body has just by existing.

component_tiers.goal: Find the survival probability of a structure of N = 10 parts under stress σ = 0.5 (in units of the characteristic part strength) when the Weibull modulus is m = 3.

vars.σ: applied stress, in units of the characteristic strength of one part
vars.m: Weibull modulus (how uniform the parts are)

component_tiers.method: Weakest-link statistics: the structure survives only if every part survives, so single-part survival probabilities multiply, which turns the exponent into a sum over N parts.

accelerator_physics.goal: Find the bending radius (m) of a 7000 GeV/c proton beam in 8.33 T dipoles.
accelerator_physics.method: The Lorentz force qvB supplies the centripetal force, so p = qBρ; for a unit charge, p in GeV/c equals 0.2998 times the magnetic rigidity Bρ in T m.

nanochemistry.goal: Find the diameter (nm) of a (10,10) armchair carbon nanotube, with graphene lattice constant a = 0.246 nm.

vars.n: chiral index (n,n) of the armchair tube

nanochemistry.method: The circumference is the length of the chiral vector a·sqrt(n^2 + nm + m^2); with m = n this is a·n·sqrt(3), then divide by π.

geometric_topology.goal: Find the genus of a closed orientable surface triangulated with V = 10 vertices, E = 36 edges and F = 24 faces.
geometric_topology.method: The Euler characteristic V - E + F is a topological invariant equal to 2 - 2g for an orientable surface with g handles; solve for g.

superacid_chemistry.goal: Find the Hammett acidity H0 of an acid in which the indicator (pK of BH+ = -10.1) is 100 times more protonated than not.

vars.pK: pKa of the protonated indicator BH+
vars.r: ratio [BH+]/[B] of protonated to free indicator

superacid_chemistry.method: Hammett extended pH to concentrated acids by measuring how far a weak-base indicator is protonated: H0 = pK + log10([B]/[BH+]). Convert log10 to natural logs.

protein_folding.goal: Find the time (s) a 30-residue chain would need to try every conformation if each residue has 3 states and each try takes 1e-13 s (Levinthal's paradox).
protein_folding.method: Independent choices multiply, so the conformations grow exponentially with chain length; a blind search must visit them one at a time.

supramolecular_chemistry.goal: Find the Gibbs energy of binding (kJ/mol) of a host-guest complex with association constant K = 1e6 at 298 K.
supramolecular_chemistry.method: At equilibrium ΔG = 0, so the standard free energy is tied to the equilibrium constant by ΔG° = -RT ln K; tighter binding means more negative ΔG.

mass_manipulation.goal: Find the energy (GeV) of a particle with momentum 3 GeV/c and mass 4 GeV/c^2, in units where c = 1 (set m = 0 to see massless matter).
mass_manipulation.method: The four-momentum has invariant length m: E^2 - p^2 = m^2 in every frame. Rest mass is only one contribution to energy; a massless particle has E = p.

general_relativity.goal: Find the Schwarzschild radius (m) of the Sun, mass 1.989e30 kg.
general_relativity.method: In the Schwarzschild metric the time component is 1 - 2GM/(rc^2), which vanishes at the horizon; equivalently, set the Newtonian escape speed equal to c.

quantum_biology.goal: Find the probability that an electron tunnels through a 0.3 nm protein barrier with decay constant κ = 10 nm^-1.

vars.κ: decay constant of the wavefunction in the barrier (nm^-1)

quantum_biology.method: Inside a classically forbidden barrier the wavefunction decays as exp(-κx); the transmission is the squared amplitude ratio across the width.

dyson_swarm.goal: Find the starlight flux (W/m^2) a statite receives at 1 AU (1.496e11 m) from a star of luminosity 3.828e26 W.
dyson_swarm.method: All the power crosses every sphere around the star, so divide it by the sphere's surface area; the flux falls off with the inverse square of distance.

nucleosynthesis.goal: Find the energy (MeV) released when four hydrogen atoms fuse into one helium-4 atom (atomic masses in u, 1 u = 931.5 MeV).
nucleosynthesis.method: The products weigh less than the reactants; the missing mass is converted to energy by E = mc^2, and c^2 is 931.5 MeV per atomic mass unit.

string_theory.goal: Find the frequency (Hz) of the 3rd harmonic of a string of length 0.5 m, tension 100 N and linear density 0.01 kg/m - each mode is a different 'particle'.
string_theory.method: Waves travel along the string at sqrt(T/μ); a string fixed at both ends only supports standing waves fitting an integer number of half-wavelengths.

neurobiology.goal: Find the potassium equilibrium potential (V) of a neuron at 310 K with 5 mM K+ outside and 140 mM inside.
neurobiology.expr: R * T / F * ln ( co / ci )
neurobiology.method: At equilibrium the electrical work zFE balances the chemical potential difference RT ln(co/ci) of a monovalent ion across the membrane (Nernst equation).

dyson_sphere.goal: Find the equilibrium temperature (K) of a Dyson shell at r = 0.7 AU around a star of L = 0.5 solar luminosities, radiating only outward.
dyson_sphere.method: The shell must re-emit the whole luminosity from its outer surface: L = 4πr^2σT^4. For the Sun at 1 AU that gives 394 K; scale as L^(1/4) and r^(-1/2).

morphogenesis.goal: Find the relative morphogen concentration C/C0 at x = 50 µm from the source, with D = 10 µm^2/s and degradation rate k = 0.001 /s.
morphogenesis.method: In steady state, diffusion D C'' balances degradation k C; the solution decays exponentially with length scale sqrt(D/k), turning one source into a positional gradient.

xenobiology.goal: Find how many bits a 100-letter genome stores in an 8-letter (hachimoji-like) genetic alphabet.
xenobiology.method: There are b^L possible sequences; the information is the base-2 logarithm of that count, and change of base turns log2 into a ratio of natural logs.

grand_unification.goal: Find the inverse U(1) coupling at Q = 1e16 GeV, given 1/α = 59 at μ = 91.2 GeV and one-loop coefficient b = 4.1.
grand_unification.expr: a - b / ( 2 * π ) * ln ( Q / μ )

vars.a: inverse coupling 1/α at the reference scale

grand_unification.method: At one loop the renormalisation group makes each inverse coupling run linearly in the log of energy; the three lines nearly meet near 1e16 GeV.

island_of_stability.goal: Find the liquid-drop fissility of flerovium-298 (Z = 114, A = 298) with surface coefficient 17.8 MeV and Coulomb coefficient 0.711 MeV.
island_of_stability.method: Compare the Coulomb energy (pushing apart, ~ Z^2/A^(1/3)) with twice the surface energy (holding together, ~ A^(2/3)) of a slightly deformed drop; near x = 1 only shell effects at magic numbers keep a fission barrier.

black_hole_interior.goal: Find the maximum proper time (s) an infaller can survive between the horizon and the singularity of a 10 solar-mass black hole (M = 1.989e31 kg).
black_hole_interior.method: Inside the horizon r is a time coordinate; the longest path to r = 0 is free fall from rest at the horizon, a cycloid-like geodesic lasting π rs/(2c).

abiogenesis.goal: Find the longest genome (bases) a replicator can keep without an error catastrophe if its master sequence has selective advantage 10 and per-base copying fidelity 0.99.

vars.s: selective superiority of the master sequence

abiogenesis.method: The master sequence survives only if its advantage outweighs the chance of copying it perfectly, s·q^L > 1; take logs and use ln q ≈ -(1 - q) (Eigen's error threshold).

transfinite_mathematics.goal: Show how many more subsets the power set of the power set of a 3-element set has than the power set itself (Cantor: each step is strictly bigger).

vars.n: number of elements of the starting set S

transfinite_mathematics.method: A set of size k has 2^k subsets (each element is in or out); apply this twice. Cantor's diagonal argument shows 2^k > k holds even for infinite k, giving an endless ladder of infinities.

paradox_engineering.goal: Show how many reduced words of length n = 5 exist in the free group on two generators, the engine of the Banach-Tarski paradox.
paradox_engineering.method: The first letter can be any of a, a⁻¹, b, b⁻¹; each later letter has 3 choices because it may not cancel the previous one. This exponential self-similarity lets the group be split into pieces that rebuild two copies of itself.

axiom_theory.goal: Find the Gödel number of the three-symbol formula whose symbol codes are 3, 1 and 2.
axiom_theory.method: Raise the i-th prime to the code of the i-th symbol and multiply; unique prime factorisation lets the formula be decoded back, so statements about axioms become statements about numbers.

reality_breach.goal: Find the Bekenstein bound (bits) on the information inside a proton of radius 0.87 fm and energy 938 MeV, with ħc = 197.3 MeV fm - the most any region can hold before physics breaks.

vars.ħc: reduced Planck constant times c (MeV fm)

reality_breach.method: Lower the system into a black hole: the horizon area, and so its entropy, may not decrease, which caps the entropy at 2πkRE/(ħc). Divide by k ln 2 to count bits.

pleroma.goal: Find the Gibbs energy of mixing (kJ) when one mole each of N = 1000 different ideal fluids is poured together at 300 K.

vars.N: number of different fluids (one mole each)

pleroma.method: Ideal mixing has no enthalpy change, only entropy: ΔG = RT Σ n_i ln x_i. With N equal components each mole fraction is 1/N.
